title: ci(half-state-patrol): run objectstack's composite action pinned to a sha instead of checking out objectstack `main` — objectui's half of objectstack-ai/objectstack#18471 (ruling 只做②)
body:
Filing gate: **④ coordination-node child.** objectui's half of objectstack-ai/objectstack#18471, ruling 只做② (`5713650969`, maintainer 「9593 A,其他同意」). Filed by `domain:devx` seat 2 (objectui#10917), `session_01TdiauJaVCHuj45EzZGUxHh`, on the maintainer's direct order (R4 marker `5905019353`).

- **Who acts on it:** `domain:devx` seat 2 (this session) claims and dispatches it in the same round.
- **Duplicate check:** all objectui `domain:devx` issues, open and closed (551), against `half-state|半状态|patrol|check-half-states|18471|18466|composite action`.
  - 9 hits, all closed and an older scope (installing or porting the patrol): #10063, #9842, #9395, #9317, #8740, #8043, #7852, #5986, #5791.
  - None is open.

## Premise (read on objectui `main`)

- `.github/workflows/half-state-patrol.yml` checks out `objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `main`, unpinned. The file says so itself: "The checkout is NOT pinned to a sha: each run executes objectstack's `main`".
- It then runs `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` from that checkout. Its prose is adopted from objectstack PR #11294.
- The ruling requires the opposite: `uses:` **pinned to a sha, ⛔ never `@main`**, with per-board constants passed as `with:` inputs, and the copies deleted.

## Target

- Replace the checkout and run steps with `uses: objectstack-ai/objectstack/.github/actions/half-state-patrol@<40-char sha>` (landed in objectstack PR #19225 as `43d492ff9`).
  - Pass objectui's board constants through the action's declared inputs: `github-token` (required), `anchor-issue` and `closed-floor`.
  - Keep objectui's own trigger, schedule, permissions and concurrency.
- The sha is the action's newest commit on objectstack `main` at implementation time (`9e9bb4641` when this card was filed). The PR body records it and the date it was read; a later bump is a one-line sha change.
- Delete the adopted prose that now describes upstream mechanics this repo no longer carries.
- Correct everything that pins the old shape in the same PR: the Half-State Patrol section of `content/docs/guide/ci-cd-pipeline.md`, and any `scripts/__tests__/**` that reads this workflow's text.

## Acceptance

- One PR in objectui.
- The workflow's `uses:` line pins a 40-character sha and no `@main` remains.
- The patrol still reads this board with the same constants. The dev proves it with the repo's workflow-lint and harness tests, plus one run of the patrol (manual dispatch or the PR's own trigger, whichever the workflow allows), with the run linked.
- `Clause-②`: no (CI wiring, no published contract).
- When this lands, objectstack-ai/objectstack#18471's `Blocked-by:` line naming this card clears.
